scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s start by copying code and syntax by hand. Reading the code out loud will help you internalize the basics.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Handwriting and reading out loud? Hmm... But I do understand the importance of fundamentals! I’ll give it my best♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Yeah, this reminds me of an old university class... We had to copy code by hand and read it out loud. So nostalgic.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: A few hours later... Megumi continues diligently copying the code by hand.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: "Semicolon at the end of the statement!!..." Umm, {{playerName}}-senpai, saying this out loud is kind of embarrassing...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Reading out loud is important too. It helps you understand the flow of the program.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi’s working really hard, but... I feel like she hasn’t made much progress.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai... Am I really learning this? It kinda feels like I’m just copying characters without understanding...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: This is bad... At this pace, she won’t be ready for M1GP in time. Handwriting might not be the most efficient method after all.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Hmm... This approach might be too time-consuming. Let’s try a different method. Maybe change locations too—make it more hands-on.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yeah... Honestly, I don’t feel like I’m really understanding it by handwriting. I want to try learning by actually running code on a computer.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: A perfect chance to be alone together! Where should you work?

options.text: In Nara Park, surrounded by nature
